---
title: "Internet + rnaturalearth diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r test}
out <- character(0)

# Test 1: outbound internet
tryCatch({
  con <- url("https://www.google.com", open = "r")
  close(con)
  out <- c(out, "Internet: YES")
}, error = function(e) {
  out <<- c(out, sprintf("Internet: NO — %s", e$message))
})

# Test 2: rnaturalearth download
tryCatch({
  library(rnaturalearth)
  b <- ne_countries(country = "Bangladesh", returnclass = "sf", scale = "medium")
  out <- c(out, sprintf("rnaturalearth: OK — %d features", nrow(b)))
}, error = function(e) {
  out <<- c(out, sprintf("rnaturalearth: FAILED — %s", e$message))
})

writeLines(out, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_internet.txt")
cat(paste(out, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```
